description: DEVOS-011 + DEVOS-012: Login screen (AuthViewModel + Chrome Custom Tab OAuth) and SecureTokenRepository in core-security. Depends on FEAT-001 (design system), FEAT-002 (nav graph), FEAT-003 (feature-auth module setup, OAuthProvider model). Independent unit: can be implemented after FEAT-003.
steps: 1. Implement core/core-security/src/main/kotlin/com/devos/ai/core/security/SecureTokenRepository.kt as an interface: suspend fun saveToken(provider: OAuthProvider, token: String); suspend fun getToken(provider: OAuthProvider): String?; suspend fun clearToken(provider: OAuthProvider); suspend fun hasToken(provider: OAuthProvider): Boolean. Import OAuthProvider from feature-auth — NOTE: this creates a cross-module dependency. To keep core-security pure, define a minimal ProviderKey sealed class in core-security instead and have OAuthProvider implement/map to it. Decision: define `interface TokenKey { val prefKey: String }` in core-security; OAuthProvider implements TokenKey in feature-auth.

2. Implement core/core-security/src/main/kotlin/com/devos/ai/core/security/SecureTokenRepositoryImpl.kt. @Singleton @Inject constructor(@ApplicationContext context: Context). Creates EncryptedSharedPreferences with MasterKey AES256_GCM scheme. saveToken: prefs.edit().putString(key.prefKey, token).apply() then Timber.d log masked token.take(4)+'****'. getToken: prefs.getString(key.prefKey, null). clearToken: prefs.edit().remove(key.prefKey).apply(). hasToken: getToken(key) != null. NEVER log the raw token value.

3. Create core/core-security/src/main/kotlin/com/devos/ai/core/security/SecurityModule.kt. @Module @InstallIn(SingletonComponent). @Binds @Singleton fun bindSecureTokenRepository(impl: SecureTokenRepositoryImpl): SecureTokenRepository.

4. Write core/core-security/src/test/kotlin/com/devos/ai/core/security/SecureTokenRepositoryTest.kt. Tests: saveToken stores value retrievable by getToken; clearToken makes getToken return null; hasToken returns true after save; hasToken returns false after clear. NOTE: EncryptedSharedPreferences requires Android context so these are Robolectric or AndroidTest tests. If Robolectric not in deps, write as @MediumTest with TestCoroutineDispatcher and note they require instrumented test runner.

5. Create feature/feature-auth/src/main/kotlin/com/devos/ai/feature/auth/repository/AuthRepository.kt interface: suspend fun exchangeCodeForToken(code: String, provider: OAuthProvider): Result<String>. Also AuthRepositoryImpl stub that returns Result.failure(NotImplementedError()) — real implementation needs a backend API endpoint (DEVOS-041).

6. Create feature/feature-auth/src/main/kotlin/com/devos/ai/feature/auth/usecase/ExchangeCodeForTokenUseCase.kt. @Inject constructor(authRepository, tokenRepository, dispatcher). invoke(code, provider): withContext(dispatcher) { authRepository.exchangeCodeForToken(code, provider).onSuccess { token -> tokenRepository.saveToken(provider, token) }.map { Unit } }.
7. Create feature/feature-auth/src/main/kotlin/com/devos/ai/feature/auth/login/LoginUiState.kt (sealed interface: Idle, Loading, Success, Error(message)).
8. Create feature/feature-auth/src/main/kotlin/com/devos/ai/feature/auth/login/AuthNavEvent.kt (sealed class: NavigateToHome).

9. Create feature/feature-auth/src/main/kotlin/com/devos/ai/feature/auth/login/AuthViewModel.kt. @HiltViewModel. @Inject constructor(ExchangeCodeForTokenUseCase, @ApplicationContext context). _uiState MutableStateFlow<LoginUiState>(Idle). _navEvent MutableSharedFlow<AuthNavEvent>. fun loginWithGitHub() / loginWithGitLab(): build Chrome Custom Tab Intent with CustomTabsIntent.Builder().build(), launch with context. fun handleAuthCallback(code, provider): launch viewModelScope { _uiState.value = Loading; exchangeCodeForTokenUseCase(code, provider).onSuccess { _uiState.value = Success; _navEvent.emit(NavigateToHome) }.onFailure { _uiState.value = Error(it.message ?: 'Login failed') } }. OAuth URLs: GitHub = 'https://github.com/login/oauth/authorize?client_id=PLACEHOLDER&scope=repo', GitLab = 'https://gitlab.com/oauth/authorize?client_id=PLACEHOLDER&response_type=code&scope=api'. Store PLACEHOLDER as a constant — never hardcode real keys.

10. Create feature/feature-auth/src/main/res/drawable/ic_github.xml — simple vector path for GitHub octocat outline (24dp viewBox, path data for a simplified octocat, or a simple circle with 'G' text if SVG path unavailable).
11. Create feature/feature-auth/src/main/res/drawable/ic_gitlab.xml — simple vector for GitLab fox logo or placeholder.

12. Create feature/feature-auth/src/main/kotlin/com/devos/ai/feature/auth/login/LoginScreen.kt. Stateless: takes uiState, onLoginGitHub, onLoginGitLab, modifier. Scaffold(topBar = DevOSTopBar('Sign In')). Column center: Text 'Welcome to DevOS AI' headlineMedium, Spacer sm, Text 'Connect your repository host to get started.' bodyMedium onSurfaceVariant textAlign Center, Spacer xl, DevOSButton('Continue with GitHub', primary, leadingIcon=ic_github), Spacer base, DevOSButton('Continue with GitLab', secondary, leadingIcon=ic_gitlab), if Error: Spacer base + DevOSErrorState(message, onRetry=null). Collect navEvent flow in LaunchedEffect.

13. Update feature/feature-auth/src/main/kotlin/com/devos/ai/feature/auth/navigation/AuthNavigation.kt to add fun NavGraphBuilder.authNavigation(navController): composable(DevOSRoutes.LOGIN) { LoginScreen + AuthViewModel via hiltViewModel() }.
14. Update app/src/main/kotlin/com/devos/ai/navigation/DevOSNavGraph.kt: replace PlaceholderScreen for LOGIN with authNavigation(navController) call.

15. Update app/src/main/AndroidManifest.xml deep link intent-filter to add android:host='auth' and android:pathPrefix='/callback' to the existing devos:// scheme filter. This ensures devos://auth/callback routes back to MainActivity for the OAuth code.
16. Update .kiro/implementation-status.md: change DEVOS-005 through DEVOS-012 from 🔴 to 🟢. Update the Build Health table. Add entries to the Completion Log table.

17. Write unit tests: feature/feature-auth/src/test/kotlin/com/devos/ai/feature/auth/AuthViewModelTest.kt. Test: loginWithGitHub sets uiState to Loading then attempts Chrome Custom Tab (mock context); handleAuthCallback success navigates to Home; handleAuthCallback failure sets Error state with message. Use UnconfinedTestDispatcher + MockK.
18. Write unit tests: ExchangeCodeForTokenUseCaseTest.kt. Test: successful exchange calls tokenRepository.saveToken; failed exchange returns Result.failure without calling saveToken.
19. Run ./gradlew :feature:feature-auth:testDebugUnitTest — fix all failures.
20. Run ./gradlew :core:core-security:assembleDebug — verify compiles.
21. Run ./gradlew assembleDebug testDebugUnitTest — full verification.
acceptance_criteria: SecureTokenRepositoryImpl.saveToken logs only token.take(4)+'****' — no raw token value in any log call
LoginScreen has two DevOSButton entries: 'Continue with GitHub' (primary) and 'Continue with GitLab' (secondary)
LoginScreen shows DevOSErrorState when uiState is LoginUiState.Error
AndroidManifest.xml deep link filter includes host='auth' and path prefix='/callback'
.kiro/implementation-status.md shows DEVOS-005 through DEVOS-012 as complete (🟢)
